metas.name: Parks and Recreation
metas.description: You enjoyed the optimistic and character-driven humor of 'Ted Lasso' and 'The Good Place'. This show offers a similar heartwarming and hilarious look at public service with a beloved ensemble cast.

metas.name: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
metas.description: Similar to 'New Girl' and 'Silicon Valley', this is a workplace comedy with a strong ensemble and witty dialogue. It's light, fast-paced, and consistently funny.

metas.name: The Office (US)
metas.description: If you liked the comedic mockumentary style of 'Silicon Valley' and the character dynamics of 'New Girl', you'll appreciate this iconic sitcom's blend of cringe humor and surprising heart.

metas.name: Schitt's Creek
metas.description: You enjoyed the character development and humor in shows like 'New Girl' and 'The Good Place'. This show starts with a fish-out-of-water premise and evolves into a deeply feel-good story with brilliant comedic performances.

metas.name: Community
metas.description: Given your appreciation for meta-humor and pop culture references in shows like 'It's Always Sunny in Philadelphia' and 'Rick and Morty', 'Community's' clever writing and genre-bending episodes will be a hit.

metas.name: Abbott Elementary
metas.description: This mockumentary sitcom shares the optimistic and character-focused humor of 'Parks and Recreation' and 'Ted Lasso', offering a charming and laugh-out-loud look at dedicated teachers in a Philadelphia public school.

metas.name: What We Do in the Shadows
metas.description: You enjoyed the absurd and unconventional humor of 'It's Always Sunny in Philadelphia' and 'Peep Show'. This mockumentary about vampire roommates delivers hilarious situations with deadpan delivery.

metas.name: Bojack Horseman
metas.description: While it has dramatic undertones, the sharp wit and satirical take on Hollywood will appeal to your appreciation for intelligent comedy like 'Master of None' and 'Silicon Valley'. It's a darker but often hilarious animated gem.

metas.name: Futurama
metas.description: You've already watched this, but it's a perfect example of your taste for animated sci-fi comedies. If you somehow missed any episodes, revisit it!

metas.name: Invincible
metas.description: You liked the action-adventure and sci-fi elements of 'Fallout' and 'Angels of Death', as well as the adult animation of 'Rick and Morty'. This superhero series offers incredible action with a compelling story and adult themes.

metas.name: The Marvelous Mrs. Maisel
metas.description: With its sharp dialogue, vibrant setting, and a protagonist finding her voice, this show offers a delightful comedic experience similar to 'Master of None' and 'New Girl', but with a historical flair.

metas.name: The Great British Bake Off
metas.description: You've watched reality shows like 'America's Next Top Model' and 'Gogglebox'. This is a highly-rated, incredibly wholesome, and low-stakes reality competition that's pure comfort viewing.

metas.name: Trial & Error
metas.description: This show parodies true-crime documentaries with a delightful absurdist humor, which should appeal to your taste for quirky comedies like 'Dirk Gently's Holistic Detective Agency' and 'It's Always Sunny in Philadelphia'.

metas.name: Archer
metas.description: If you enjoy witty, fast-paced, and often absurd adult animation like 'Rick and Morty' and 'Futurama', Archer's spy-spoofing antics and sharp humor will be a great fit.

metas.name: Dave
metas.description: This show offers a blend of comedy and drama with a unique perspective, similar to 'Master of None' and 'Silicon Valley', exploring the life of a budding rapper with relatable and often hilarious situations.

metas.name: Wellington Paranormal
metas.description: For fans of dry, absurd humor and mockumentary style like 'What We Do in the Shadows', this spin-off follows two hapless police officers investigating supernatural occurrences in Wellington, New Zealand.

metas.name: Detectorists
metas.description: This is a gentle, witty, and incredibly charming comedy about two friends who spend their free time metal detecting. It's the epitome of feel-good, character-driven British television, much like 'Gogglebox' in its observational warmth.

metas.name: Upload
metas.description: Given your enjoyment of 'The Good Place' and 'Dirk Gently's Holistic Detective Agency', this sci-fi comedy explores a futuristic afterlife with humor, romance, and intriguing plotlines. It's light but thought-provoking.

metas.name: What If...?
metas.description: You enjoyed the animated sci-fi and alternate universe concepts in 'Rick and Morty' and 'Futurama'. This Marvel series explores different timelines and possibilities within the MCU, offering fun and imaginative stories.

metas.name: Bob's Burgers
metas.description: Similar to 'King of the Hill' in its animated family sitcom format, 'Bob's Burgers' offers consistently funny, character-driven humor with a quirky and lovable family at its core. It's known for its positivity.

metas.name: Crazy Ex-Girlfriend
metas.description: This musical comedy-drama blends sharp wit, catchy songs, and genuine emotional depth, appealing to your appreciation for innovative comedy like 'The Good Place' and 'Master of None'.

metas.name: The IT Crowd
metas.description: Fans of quirky British sitcoms like 'Peep Show' and 'Goodness Gracious Me' will love this. It's a smart and hilarious show about a group of misfits working in the IT department of a corporation.

metas.name: Mythbusters
metas.description: You've already watched this, a fantastic example of a fun, educational, and inherently watchable documentary series. If you need more of this style, consider similar science-based entertainment.

metas.name: The Mindy Project
metas.description: This show offers a blend of romantic comedy and sharp wit, similar to 'New Girl' and 'Master of None', following a quirky OB/GYN navigating her personal and professional life.

metas.name: Disenchantment
metas.description: From the creators of 'The Simpsons' and 'Futurama', this animated fantasy comedy offers a similar blend of humor and adventure that you've enjoyed in other animated series.

metas.name: Dead Pixels
metas.description: If you enjoyed the comedic take on a niche community in 'Silicon Valley' and the humor of 'It's Always Sunny in Philadelphia', this show about a group of gamers obsessed with an online MMORPG offers relatable and hilarious situations.

metas.name: Taskmaster
metas.description: This is a highly entertaining and quirky British comedy panel show where comedians compete in absurd challenges. It's pure, lighthearted fun similar to the spirit of shows like 'Top Buzzer' but with a creative twist.

metas.name: Bluey
metas.description: While a children's show, 'Bluey' is lauded for its incredible writing, humor, and heartwarming themes that resonate deeply with adults. It's universally feel-good and incredibly creative, akin to the positive vibes of 'Ted Lasso'.

metas.name: Barry
metas.description: This show cleverly blends dark comedy and drama, featuring a hitman who wants to become an actor. Its unique premise and sharp humor will appeal to fans of 'It's Always Sunny in Philadelphia' and 'Brassic'.

metas.name: Space Force
metas.description: From the creators of 'The Office (US)', this workplace comedy with a sci-fi twist offers a similar comedic sensibility and ensemble cast humor that you've enjoyed in shows like 'Silicon Valley'.

metas.name: Avenue 5
metas.description: Fans of Armando Iannucci's satirical humor, as seen in 'Silicon Valley's' tech world satire, will enjoy this sci-fi comedy about a luxury space cruise that goes hilariously wrong.

metas.name: Young Justice
metas.description: You enjoyed 'One-Punch Man' and 'Angels of Death' for their animated action and adventure. This DC animated series offers compelling storylines, great character development, and exciting superhero action.

metas.name: The Wrong Mans
metas.description: This British comedy thriller offers a fun, fast-paced adventure with characters stumbling into increasingly dangerous and absurd situations, much like the enjoyable chaos of 'Brassic' or 'Dirk Gently'.

metas.name: The Midnight Gospel
metas.description: If you appreciate the mind-bending philosophical and sci-fi elements of 'Rick and Morty' and 'The Good Place', this animated series uses interview footage with spiritual figures to explore existential questions in a visually stunning and often profound way.

metas.name: Milo Murphy's Law
metas.description: This animated Disney show features a protagonist who is the embodiment of Murphy's Law, leading to hilariously chaotic and creative problem-solving. It's a fun and optimistic watch, similar to the spirit of 'The Good Place'.

metas.name: Black Mirror
metas.description: While some episodes can be dark, the innovative storytelling and thought-provoking sci-fi concepts in 'Black Mirror' might appeal to your enjoyment of shows like 'Rick and Morty' and 'Dirk Gently's Holistic Detective Agency', offering a more mature take on technology and society.

metas.name: Derry Girls
metas.description: This hilarious coming-of-age comedy set in Northern Ireland during the Troubles will appeal to your taste for witty dialogue and relatable, albeit chaotic, teen experiences, similar to 'New Girl' and 'It's Always Sunny in Philadelphia'.

metas.name: American Dad!
metas.description: From the creator of 'Family Guy', this animated sitcom offers a unique brand of satirical humor and eccentric characters, sharing the comedic DNA of 'King of the Hill' and 'Futurama' with its own distinct flavor.

metas.name: The Last Man on Earth
metas.description: This show takes a comedic approach to a post-apocalyptic world, featuring a group of survivors with quirky personalities and a great ensemble dynamic. It's a fun and optimistic take on a bleak scenario, similar to the humor in 'It's Always Sunny in Philadelphia'.
